invariant: H0-I5: a readable source, a successful page read, a process exit, a DSH turn/end or a canonical Attempt result must not independently imply complete execution coverage or successful Work settlement
completenessRule: COMPLETE requires sessionLifecycle === SESSION_READ AND eventPageCoverage === FULL AND canonical result facts AND project context

attributedPartialPage_50of200.caveatStates: the page returned fewer events than the source reports

attributedFullPage_50of50.note: the rule is not simply 'never complete'

syntheticRecoveryCloserPresent.caveat: synthetic closers are NOT evidence that the original execution completed successfully

structuredCurrentness.before: staleBasis was derived by scanning caveat text for the word 'stale'
structuredCurrentness.after: staleBasis is derived from the STRUCTURED basisVector.completeness (COMPLETE | INCOMPLETE | RACED)
structuredCurrentness.measurement: an INCOMPLETE basis with no keyword caveat yields staleBasis true; a COMPLETE basis with a caveat containing 'stale' yields false

canonicalWorkFailureDistinguished.before: every T0 projection failure collapsed into one 'could not be built' caveat
canonicalWorkFailureDistinguished.after: a TrajectoryRefusal names a CANONICAL WORK SOURCE integrity failure; any other failure names an optional cross-owner plane

evidenceClass: CONTROLLED_FIXTURE (the attributed state models a future verified binding; it does NOT claim a real producer)
